text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Today's the day! I just know I'm gonna win this time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah! I've trained so hard, and eaten so many carrots, how could I not be?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Although, I might've had a few too many
carrots, hehe. I'm sure it's
fine!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So this is where you've been.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We're here to cheer you on, Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: King! Spe! Thanks for coming, guys!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You trained with the mighty King Halo
herself, you only have to go
out there and
win now.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no problem! I'm definitely winning
this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know you can do it! Just remember your
training, and you'll soar
down the track!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Remember my training... Okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'll just think of all the times you stuffed
your face with snacks! Or the
time you
tripped and got covered in mud!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-you don't have to remember those parts of training!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The third tryout race will begin shortly.
Runners, please make your
way to the
starting gate.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's me! I better get going!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Don't take your eyes off me,
okay? See you after the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, Haru Urara's tryout race begins.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners are racing through the dirt
course, no doubt with the
Twinkle Series
on their minds!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Now who's this bringing up the rear? Why,
it's Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Could she be conserving her energy...
doesn't look like it! She's giving
it her all,
but she's still trailing behind the pack!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Urara!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text: Go, Urara, go!

text_block_list.name: Neighbor Lady
text_block_list.text: Show them what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who has had their spirits lifted by
Haru Urara's infectious
optimism has
gathered to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the race reaches its conclusion...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
...And across the line! Our winner has
finished, followed shortly by the
rest of
the pack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Will the ever-upbeat racer's hard work pay
off at long last? Haru
Urara's final
placement is...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Ninth place! I've never done that
well before!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Urara! That was an
amazing race.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You gave it your all, right up to
the very end.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's the exciting thing about
races. You never know what's
gonna
happen!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Good job today, Urara. Here, these carrots
are on the house!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Yippee! This is just what I need to
prepare for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Haru Urara finishes ninth out of
ten runners.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, that takes care of the tryouts. What
a blast!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I still can't believe it. Ninth place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But I just know I'll take first place next time! I can't wait until the next tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being so optimistic in the face of defeat
isn't as simple as she makes
it look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's what makes Haru Urara so
compelling to the people
around her...
including me.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're really gonna help me train
some more?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Scouting me...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What?! You want to recruit ME?! Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yippee! Then that means I can run in the
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I make my debut there, I'll be able to
run in all sorts of races!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And I'll get first place in every single one!
Oooh, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for scouting me! I'll make it worth
your while and win lots and
lots of races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that decree, my journey with the
endlessly optimistic Haru Urara
begins.
